title: Authenticated Creator Handle Claim HTTP and Runtime Boundary
summary: Expose the SESH-038 one-time creator handle claim operation through a narrow authenticated same-origin HTTP boundary and canonical runtime composition.
invariants: The route is server rendered and POST only.
The request must pass the existing Sesh same-origin write guard before claim execution.
The JSON body must be a non-array object containing exactly one field named handle.

Client supplied principalId, seshCreatorId, creatorId, createdAt, profile identity, lifecycle fields, rights fields, release fields, rename fields, and unknown fields are rejected before operation execution.
The runtime derives PrincipalId from the canonical authenticated Astro session.
PrincipalId resolves to SeshCreatorId only through the explicit identity mapping repository.
The claim operation uses the canonical Sesh handle reservation repository in SESH_DB.
The route exposes no release or rename method.
The route does not write SeshCreatorProfile.handle.
The route grants no project, collaborator, publishing, management, legal, copyright, CRM, account, or ownership rights beyond the canonical handle reservation itself.
